verdict.rationale: Ollama's REST API allows loading different models per request (managed via ollama pull/rm), and community hands-on evidence confirms hotswapping models without restarting the server is a key advantage (ollama-comm-4), plus pricing docs confirm running multiple models concurrently (ollama-docs-17). missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly detailing concurrent model loading/unloading behavior and memory limits, and independent benchmarks of switch latency.
